body_html:
The Basics Elora high-back chair pairs a polished black Luxhide finish with a full suite of ergonomic adjustments, so it looks at home in a private office while supporting long working days. A multi-tilter mechanism, sliding seat, and height-adjustable back let each user dial in a posture that keeps shoulders relaxed and the lower back properly supported. It is a confident, professional seat that fits executive offices, clinics, and institutional workspaces alike.

Features

  • Multi-tilter mechanism with adjustable tilt tension and an infinite tilt lock
  • Pneumatic seat-height adjustment for feet-flat positioning
  • Sliding seat for individual seat-depth adjustment
  • Height-adjustable back with adjustable back angle for targeted lumbar support
  • Sliding, pivoting, height- and width-adjustable arms
  • High-back design upholstered in durable black Luxhide
  • Five-star base on smooth-rolling dual-wheel casters

Specifications

Upholstered in black Luxhide over moulded foam, rated for users up to 275 lbs on an eight-hour single-shift basis, and proudly made in Canada by Global Furniture Group. Backed by a 2-year limited warranty covering upholstery, foam, gas cylinder and mechanism.

Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Canadian dealer (since 1964) based at 296 George St N, Peterborough ON, and an OECM-eligible supplier — Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote online or call 1-800-835-9565 for volume pricing and lead times.
